**1. Genes with zero counts in every sample**

This gene has no detected transcripts in your dataset.

It might genuinely not be expressed in these cells, or its expression might be below the sequencing detection limit.

Keeping thousands of genes like this generally adds little to an exploratory expression analysis because you cannot calculate meaningful differences in expression between conditions.
